teaser: Claude built, animated and rendered a 26-second RiskMandate film in Unreal Engine 5.8 on an unattended laptop.
core_idea: On an unattended MacBook Air, Claude used Unreal Engine 5.8's experimental MCP plugin and a folder-based job runner to design, build, animate and render a 26-second RiskMandate film about reach, mandate and gap, delivering a titled MP4 with nobody at the keyboard. The films live in a shared newsroom media vault with a published read key.

nodes.label: A job runner in a folder
nodes.summary: Runs any job, including the render.

nodes.label: The media vault
nodes.summary: Read key published; videos decrypted in the browser.

quotes.text: the oldest trick there is: a folder that a program watches
A tool reported success without doing the work.
The same loop makes a series as easily as one film

figures.caption: The six beats of the RiskMandate film, version 2, rendered in Unreal Engine 5.8 by Claude.
The loop: Claude writes a job, Unreal runs it, Movie Render Queue renders, ffmpeg encodes, the MP4 comes back.
The film's closing composition: the agent, the green mandate, the barrier ring and the reach.
Version 1 and version 2 of the film: resolution, render time, geometry, materials, lighting and samples.
